name: Entypo+ Social
about: Entypo+ Social is a free, open-source icon set with 76 icons designed by Daniel Bruce. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Entypo+ Social free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 76 Entypo+ Social are open source under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY-SA 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Entypo+ Social in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Entypo+ Social are there?
faqs.a: There are 76 icons in the Entypo+ Social set, designed by Daniel Bruce. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Entypo+ Social?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Entypo+ Social available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
